text: Heterogeneity I2 definition (from M5.03 salvage review, PR #45, docs/verification/umvpa-group-salvage-20261010): qualify the Q-based Higgins-Thompson I2 = max(0,(Q-df)/Q) as the primary reported value; it is what main, the unmerged parallel branch and the native GroupEngine compute and is estimator-independent. metafor 4.8-0 Paule-Mandel reports a tau-based I2 (0.667 vs 0.75 on main's unequal-variance cell); the two coincide only for equal within-subject variances. Required: (a) name/document the field as Higgins-Thompson (Q-based) so it is not mistaken for metafor's tau-based value; (b) qualify against metafor in the equal-variance case and pin the unequal-variance divergence as deliberate (test already added in #45); (c) state explicitly which tau2 estimator main uses (salvage review implies Paule-Mandel; not independently verified). Optional: a separately named tau-based I2 only if a consumer needs it.
